children.value: > Fact From Story: The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried, the founder of FTX and Alameda Research, is facing seven counts of criminal charges: two counts of wire fraud, and five counts of conspiracy charges.

> > > > Fact From Story: The trial, set to last six weeks, will resume on Tuesday with key testimony expected from Ellison, who is considered the prosecution's star witness, having already pleaded guilty to multiple charges.
> > > > Fact From Story: SBF has pleaded not-guilty to some seven charges of fraud and conspiracy.
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Trials involve determining guilt or innocence based on evidence and testimony.
> > Fact From Story: SBF has pleaded not-guilty to some seven charges of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A trial is a legal proceeding to determine guilt or innocence.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A trial is held to determine whether someone is guilty of a crime.
